summary: Rate limiting of automated dialogues (ADs) on a speaker: which AD instance runs and a cooldown after it ended (act1 idle and many dialogue steps). Written by esv::dialog::ADRateLimitingSystem from its RateLimitingUpdateRequest list (RequestRateLimitingDialog(Guid, ObjectSet, float, float)). Sibling of ADRateLimitingHistoryComponent (SE Coverage.h).

fields.name: DialogId
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E14200 (called from the ADRateLimitingSystem per-frame update bg3.exe+0x2E13A00) creates the component (0x20 bytes) and copies the request's 16 bytes at element+0x10 (stride 0x38) to +0/+8; an existing component with the same 16 bytes makes the request a duplicate. RequestRateLimitingDialog's first argument is a Guid. Live: 14 distinct values over 48 instances.

fields.name: DialogInstanceId
fields.evidence: +0x10 = the uint32 returned by the ADRateLimitingSystemHelper start call (vtable +0x10), the same id SE's ADRateLimitingHistoryEntry.DialogInstanceId holds; the update bg3.exe+0x2E14670 looks it up in the system's ended/failed id sets and zeroes it. Live small ints 0..0x4B.

fields.name: DialogEnded
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E14670 sets +0x14 to 1 when the instance id is in the ended set (system+0x108), and only then counts the timer down; creator sets 0.

fields.name: Timer
fields.evidence: Default 15.0 (0x41700000); set from the request's first float (element+0x30); bg3.exe+0x2E14670 subtracts the frame delta while DialogEnded is set and removes the component at <= 0. Live 0.017..2.0.

fields.name: field_1C
fields.evidence: Default 5.0 (0x40A00000); set from the request's second float (element+0x34); not read by the update. Live 5, 10, 15, 20.

open_questions: Whether the Guid is the dialog resource id (assumed from RequestRateLimitingDialog(Guid, ...)).
